result.title: Counterfactual Feature Steering for Adjacency-Preserving Identity Unlearning
result.summary: Identity unlearning in text-to-image diffusion models is increasingly important for privacy, safety, and ethical deployment, as it aims to remove the model's ability to generate specific individuals. In this work, we study identity unlearning with \emph{adjacency preservation}, where the goal is to remove a target individual's identity while preserving related non-target identities. We propose Counterfactual Feature Steering (CFS), a method requiring one-time SAE training that performs bounded inference-time concept editing in the latent space of a sparse autoencoder attached to the text encoder. CFS derives a target direction by contrasting forget and retain distributions, then applies a per-token projection proportional to each token's current alignment with this direction, yielding counterfactual representations that suppress the target while limiting collateral damage. To evaluate adjacency preservation, we introduce the Adjacency-Weighted Unlearning Score (AWUS), which measures the tradeoff between target erasure and collateral damage, and extend it to face-specific identity similarity using ArcFace. Across 4,000 prompts derived from Celeb-100, spanning 100 celebrity identities, CFS achieves the strongest evaluated tradeoff between identity erasure of target identities and preservation of adjacent and generic concepts, while remaining stable across intervention strengths where other steering-based methods degrade. Independent ArcFace evaluation and a 10,000-caption COCO study further examine identity and general preservation. Quantitative nudity-suppression benchmarks and qualitative artistic-style examples provide evidence of transfer beyond identities on SD~1.4.

AI.brief_summary: 研究文生图扩散模型的身份遗忘：在文本编码器所挂 SAE 的潜空间中，由 forget/retain 分布对比导出目标方向并做有界的推理期编辑，同时提出 AWUS 指标衡量目标擦除与相邻身份保留的权衡。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「对比分布导出方向 + 有界潜空间编辑」可能可供核查用于抑制 latent 中的干扰内容或调制推理状态，但任务本身是图像生成遗忘，与 VLM 推理期状态生成与证据使用相距较远。
